quotes.text: - Default Access: EA and automated trading capabilities are enabled by default across all account types. No prior permission or special setup request is required.

other_conduct_bearing.value: 'tight brackets' to exploit fills prohibited; micro-scalping (under ~1 min, under 3 points / 10 ticks) prohibited; flat by 4:59 PM EST daily; one account per customer

quotes.text: - Exploiting Favorable Fills: Attempting to profit by exploiting the absence of slippage, using tight brackets, or manipulating order fills to gain an advantage is prohibited.
- Tick or Micro Scalping: Taking trades with minimal movement, such as fewer than 10 ticks, without a clear plan, and opening and closing positions quickly to make small profits, is not allowed.
You can start trading at 6 PM EST to begin a new trading day, but all trades must be closed by 4:59 PM EST each day.
